tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows mild normocytic, normochromic anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit) with a slightly elevated erythrocyte count and markedly increased platelet distribution width, suggesting possible anisocytosis or early myelodysplastic changes. Leukocyte and platelet counts are within normal limits. Correlation with clinical findings and further evaluation for underlying causes of anemia is recommended.
